name: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited
note: Listed on the JSE Main Board on 11 April 2024 (share code WBC) after Transaction Capital's unbundling; Transaction Capital no longer holds shares. Largest disclosed shareholders, from JSE beneficial-interest disclosures aggregated on the SA Shares data site (sashares.co.za, opened 2026-10-03): Public Investment Corporation 15.775% (30 March 2026), Coronation Fund Managers 14.87% (30 September 2025), I VDW Holdings 5.65% (2 February 2026), Allan Gray 5.1557% (14 July 2026), Camissa Asset Management 5.05% (15 July 2026). Founded by brothers Faan and Dirk van der Walt in 2001.
